name: HydraMIST Elite 11-in-1 hydrofacial
shortDescription: 11-in-1 multifunctional hydrofacial system: vacuum hydradermabrasion, oxygen active-ingredient delivery, RF, LED oxygen dome and much more on one platform.
description: HydraMIST Elite is a multifunctional electro-cosmetic system that combines 11 skin treatment technologies on a single platform: vacuum hydradermabrasion, ultrasonic peeling, CO₂ bubble cleansing, oxygen and ultrasonic active-ingredient delivery, multipolar RF skin tightening, ionic lifting, LED + oxygen dome and a cold therapy head. For professional salon use.

videoDescription.headline: HydraMIST Elite – 11 technologies on a single platform
paragraphs: HydraMIST Elite delivers in a single device what a salon usually needs several machines for: deep cleansing, hydration, active-ingredient delivery, skin tightening and a soothing finish. You switch between functions on the touchscreen, so within one treatment you can build a complex protocol tailored to the client's skin.

Its foundation is vacuum hydradermabrasion: liquid and vacuum together cleanse the pores, remove dead skin cells and hydrate. Built on this are needle-free oxygen and ultrasonic active-ingredient delivery, multipolar RF and the LED oxygen dome. You can find all functions below, under Treatment functions.

featureRows.headline: Why HydraMIST Elite?
featureRows.subtitle: Complex facial treatment with a single, well-designed device

features.title: Transparent oxygen dome with 360° face coverage
features.description: The dome is made of premium PC material: durable, transparent and easy to clean. It ergonomically follows the contours of the face and provides even active-ingredient delivery from every angle. The integrated protective shield prevents the mist from escaping, so the treatment stays clean and safe.
features.highlight: With the multimedia system built into the dome, music can play during the treatment.

features.title: Intuitive touchscreen, every function in one place
features.description: Every treatment mode is accessible via clear icons on the high-resolution touchscreen. Intensity and duration can be adjusted per treatment, and favourite settings can be saved with the memory function. The blue LED status indicator shows when the device is ready for treatment.
features.highlight: Quick setup, so more time is left for the client.

features.title: Precise dosing, even liquid flow
features.description: The professional liquid supply system delivers the active ingredient into the skin with stable pressure and even flow. The desired amount of liquid can be set precisely with the regulating ring on the dosing tube. The closed system is hygienic, and the tanks can be replaced quickly and easily.
features.highlight: 3 solution tanks (A/B/C) and a separate waste tank.

faq.question: What does 11-in-1 mean?
faq.answer: 11 separate handpieces and technologies in one device, from vacuum hydradermabrasion to radiofrequency and the LED oxygen dome. This means cleansing, active-ingredient delivery, tightening and a soothing finish can all be done on one machine. We present each of them above, under Treatment functions.

faq.question: Who is it recommended for?
faq.answer: For beauty salons and skincare professionals – beginners and advanced users alike. It is designed for professional salon use and requires appropriate expertise.

faq.question: How long does a treatment take?
faq.answer: Usually 60–90 minutes, depending on the chosen protocol.

faq.question: What skin types is it suitable for?
faq.answer: Almost all skin types: dry, dehydrated, oily, combination and dull skin as well. Intensities must always be adjusted to the client's skin condition, starting at a lower level for the first treatment.

faq.question: Is there downtime for the client?
faq.answer: No. The treatment is non-invasive and painless, and the client can return to daily activities immediately afterwards. Mild redness may occur, which usually subsides within a short time.

faq.question: How often is the treatment recommended?
faq.answer: Every 3–4 weeks for skin maintenance. For a more intensive skin-renewal programme, the practitioner puts together a personalised plan.

faq.question: Is it a medical device?
faq.answer: No. The device is designed for cosmetic use, does not qualify as a medical device, and is not suitable for diagnosing or treating diseases.

faq.question: What is the delivery time, and is training included?
faq.answer: Delivery time is 2–6 weeks. The purchase includes comprehensive professional training (Hungarian-language training material, treatment protocols, safety guidelines). On request, live model practical training is also available (69.990 Ft).
